name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Randy Orton puts his fangs into Cody Rhodes, costs him WWE title against CM Punk at SummerSlam
changes.summary: Cody Rhodes’ past came back to haunt him on Saturday night at SummerSlam. Rhodes was in the midst of challenging CM Punk for the Undisputed WWE Championship in one of the final matches of the night at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis. Rhodes and Punk were putting on an epic performance only those two could deliver. COM.

changes.title: In Dropping Reflecting Pool Case, Pirro Draws Trump’s Wrath
changes.summary: Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney in Washington, blamed shoddy construction, contradicting President Trump’s pet theory. Mr. Trump said he disagreed “100%” with her.

changes.title: Over 81,000 U.S. soldiers are missing from past wars. One may soon be identified
changes.summary: In June, the Department of Defense disinterred the remains of an unidentified WWII soldier who had been buried in Sitka, Alaska for decades. Now, they'll try to confirm who he is. (Image credit: Hope McKenney).

changes.title: Evidence Indicates U.S. Dropped Bomb on Residential Area in Iran, Killing 3 Civilians
changes.summary: The weapon, one of the largest in the U.S.’s arsenal, struck a house in a heavily populated area, according to a Times analysis.

changes.title: Trump’s Fixation on Arctic Ships Led to Billions in No-Bid Contracts
changes.summary: The president decided to buy 11 polar icebreakers after a game of golf with Finland’s president. Experts say it’s far from clear the United States needs so many.

changes.title: U.S., Israel preparing to bombard energy-related targets in Iran, sources say
changes.summary: The U.S. and Israel plan to hit Iran's energy infrastructure as soon as this weekend, although no final decision has been made, sources familiar with the matter told CBS News.

changes.title: A brief timeline of Iranian cyberattacks on the U.S.
changes.summary: Investigators are probing whether Iranian hackers are behind this week's malicious cyber activity against water systems in Minnesota. If they are found to be the culprits, it would not be the first time.

changes.title: Week in Politics: Todd Blanche nomination; Michigan's Democratic Senate shakeup
changes.summary: Two nominations to watch: President Trump's of Todd Blanche to be U.S. Attorney General, and who Michigan Democrats will choose Tuesday to campaign for the U.S. Senate.

changes.title: Scope of Hacks on U.S. Water Supply Widens as Evidence Points to Iran
changes.summary: Michigan and Minnesota are among at least seven states coping with cyberattacks aimed at disrupting water systems nationwide.

changes.title: Iran Plotted Wider War With Help of Its Proxies
changes.summary: During a fleeting truce, Iranians covertly devised a plan to raise the war’s costs for President Trump if U.S. forces attacked anew.
